prompt: Work autonomously and do not ask questions. Implement `sqrt_mod(a, p)` in src/lib.rs using the Tonelli-Shanks algorithm. `p` is an odd prime. Return the smallest `x` in `[0, p)` with `x^2 = a (mod p)`, or `None` when `a` is a non-residue. `sqrt_mod(0, p)` is 0. Return `None` for `p < 3` or even `p`. Keep the public API and the existing tests unchanged. Run `cargo test` and finish only when the tests pass.
